title.narrative: Journey Towards Targeted Malaria Elimination in Bangladesh - Bangladesh (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Bangladesh, Malaria, BRAC (BRAC)This program has the following goals: By 2030, interrupt local transmission of and eliminate indigenous malaria in phased manner and prevent re-establishment of local transmission. By 2027, attain zero mortality due to indigenous malaria and maintain status. The objectives of this program are: Ensure universal coverage by early case detection using quality assured parasitological test and prompt and effective treatment of all confirmed malaria cases according to national treatment guidelines through 2030. Ensure universal coverage of population at risk in targeted areas with appropriate preventive interventions through 2030. Strengthen context-specific surveillance in all malaria settings and outbreak preparedness and response through 2030. Enhance Social and Behaviour Change Communication (SBCC) with special emphasis on community engagement and mobilisation, context-specific communication and advocacy through 2030. Ensure strengthened program management, monitoring & evaluation and partnership and coordination through 2030. Carry out research to guide strategy and policy to address programme gaps and challenges through 2030. Prevent re-establishment of malaria transmission in malaria-free areas
